messages:
nora: Observing a spike of Pending GPU pods in ap-south1. Warm nodes show conntrack + egress queue pressure since ~03:20 UTC — pods stuck attaching to warm-pool leases. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yep. noticed attach/lease heartbeats failing. kubernetes events show `LeaseHeartbeatMissed` and a bunch of `AttachTimeout` for gpuresource mounts. :grimacing:

kai: node rn-warm-23: conntrack ~400k, `tc` qdisc backlog rising. netstat: lots of TIME_WAIT/close_wait. looks like a microburst of flows. grabbed logs:
```
Mar 15 03:21:02 rn-warm-23 kubelet[...]: lease heartbeat missed: 2023-03-15T03:21:02Z
Mar 15 03:21:05 rn-warm-23 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```

maria: ops-bot alert fired: `warm-pool-heartbeat-missed` for warmpool/gpu-ap-south1 at 03:22 :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Alert acknowledged by infra oncall.

sam: temporary mitigation that helped: `kubectl cordon rn-warm-23 && drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to push pods to other warmnodes; reattaching succeeded for ~6 pods but rest queued up.

kai: long-term: we should throttle attach retries and bump `lease.heartbeatTimeout` from 10s->30s for warmpool controller in ap-south1 canary. Also consider conntrack tuning on warm nodes and switch egress policing to avoid table exhaustion.

nora: cost note — the repeated attach retries kept GPUs busy longer; estimated extra bill ~ $200/hr during the spike. let's be mindful before broad rollouts.

maria: filed INFRA-3245 with summary, logs, and plan. net team assigned @ian. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3245

ian: looking into switch buffers now. seeing a burst from an internal backup job at 03:15-03:22 hitting same rack. rerouting flows off the saturated spine and clearing conntrack entries.

nora: update 03:38 UTC: after reroute conntrack dropped to ~40k, pending pods started draining, completed by 03:46. Suggest next steps: canary lease TTL bump in ap-south1, enable conntrack garbage sweep on warmnodes, and add a scheduler soft-affinity to avoid single-rack warmnode hotspots. Thoughts?

sam: +1 to canary. I'll prepare a PR with TTL change + rollout plan and rollback steps. Will include metrics dashboard for conntrack and attach-latency.

kai: if net team confirms stabilization, we can rerun canary overnight. otherwise escalate to platform for warmpool redesign. :eyes:

maria: closing loop — net team will monitor for 2h and update INFRA-3245. thanks all.
